thread:
maya (devex): Quick note from today's onboarding: both Python and Go quickstarts leaked emails/tokens in logs and the Go quickstart lost x-request-id when retrying. New hire pasted output.

rachel (sdk-py): Oof — are quickstarts still defaulting to DEBUG? That would surface tokens.

maya (devex): Yep, .env.example shows LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG. Example output:
```
INFO 2026-04-02T08:10:01Z request_id=abc-42 user_id=9 email=person@example.com model=rw-1
DEBUG 2026-04-02T08:10:01Z bearer=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR...
```

igor (sdk-go): For the Go trace issue, the sample's retry loop doesn't call req.WithContext(ctx) — so propagated headers like traceparent / x-request-id get lost and the server sees separate root spans. There's a Go SDK fix in v0.6.4 that copies context properly.

tom (sre): We should add three small actions: 1) change quickstart default to INFO, 2) enable a dev-only redaction sanitizer in example configs that strips REDACT_FIELDS (email,user_id,bearer), and 3) add an opt-in helper in telemetry examples that installs OTEL propagators and ensures request context is preserved across retries.

rachel (sdk-py): Python already has an opt-in sanitizer but quickstarts didn't enable it. I'll flip it on for the quickstarts and add a small regex to mask tokens in stack traces (replace middle with ***).

igor (sdk-go): I'll bump go sample to v0.6.4, add a note and tiny helper showing req = req.WithContext(ctx) in retry logic, and include a short snippet to set the W3C propagator so traceparent is injected.

tom (sre): Also please add an e2e that forces a 500 on first try and asserts the backend receives the same x-request-id/traceparent across attempts. Put it behind the quickstart CI gate.

ci-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts/issues/319 -> items: set info log level, enable sanitizer in quickstarts, go sample bump, telemetry helper, add retry-propagation e2e.

maya (devex): Nice. One last ask: make the example telemetry wrapper opt-in in production code but default-on in quickstart configs. Docs must show how to opt out. I'll update onboarding checklist once PRs merge.

igor (sdk-go): PRs incoming: #210 bump go sample + context fix, #211 telemetry wrapper.

rachel (sdk-py): PR #212 quickstart sanitizer + token masking.

maya (devex): Thanks team :thumbsup:
